'''Cyrillia''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Cyrillian]]s, in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was a very industrialized world where [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc.]] constructed its [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM pit droids]] in large quantities.

==History==
Cyrillia was explored sometime between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] and settlement of [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]]. It fell into the area of space known as [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The Empire abandoned the planet in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], after the [[Battle of Reytha]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], Cyrillia boasted a population of 1 to 10 billion Cyrillians.
